android.desc:
All-in-One PDF Editor, Scanner & Signer — free offline PDF tool

  The complete offline PDF toolkit for Android — no subscription, no account, no Wi-Fi needed. Scan, sign, annotate,
  merge, split, compress and more. Everything runs on your device; your files are never uploaded to any server.

  WHY PDF UTILS?
  • No subscription — upgrade once to remove ads, or use free forever
  • 100% offline — works without internet, no server uploads, no privacy concerns
  • All-in-one — 20+ PDF tools in a single free app

  CREATE
  • Document Scanner — scan to PDF with your camera. Auto edge-detection and perspective correction included.
  • Image to PDF / Photo to PDF — convert JPG, PNG, TIFF, and BMP (including pictures and photos) to PDF. Free, offline.
  • Text to PDF — convert custom text and emojis to PDF.
  • Web to PDF — share any web page to our app and save as PDF.

  SIGN & ANNOTATE
  • Sign PDF / E-Signature — draw your digital signature and stamp it onto any PDF page. Drag to reposition before
  saving.
  • Annotate PDF / Highlight PDF — freehand draw, highlight, and mark up PDF pages directly. Full undo support.
  • PDF Watermark — add text or image watermarks to your PDFs.
  • Add Page Numbers — stamp page numbers onto any PDF.

  EDIT
  • Merge PDF / Combine PDF — merge PDFs or images into a single PDF file, free. Supports Google Drive and OneDrive.
  • Split PDF — split PDFs into smaller files or extract specific pages from a PDF.
  • Reorder PDF Pages — drag and drop pages into any order.
  • Cut PDF / Extract Pages — cut pages or extract sections to reformat your content.
  • Crop PDF — crop individual pages with a visual overlay.
  • Rotate PDF — rotate pages 90, 180, or 270 degrees.
  • Delete PDF Pages — remove any PDF page with a single swipe.
  • PDF to Image — convert PDF pages to PNG or JPG.
  • Extract Images from PDF — extract embedded images from any PDF.

  PROTECT & COMPRESS
  • Compress PDF / Reduce PDF Size — reduce PDF file size with quality control. Choose compression level and preview
  results before saving. Free and offline.
  • PDF Password Protect — encrypt PDFs with owner and user passwords, or remove existing password protection.

  READ
  • PDF Reader / PDF Viewer — open and view PDFs with a smooth, customisable offline PDF viewer.

  GREAT FOR
  • Students — annotate lecture notes, merge assignments, compress files before submission
